reorder_policy_evaluation_dev.evaluation_type: Multi-period chronological evaluation with boundary simulation and native baseline audit

boundary_simulation_metrics.description: Replenishment decision accuracy when stock varies around the reorder threshold (0.5x to 1.5x ROP)

native_baseline_audit.description: Evaluation on native synthetic inventory where buffer stock was high (~1,200 units vs ~18 monthly sales)
native_baseline_audit.limitation: Native synthetic inventory generator maintained excess buffer stock; zero natural stockout events occurred. Claiming F1=1.0 on zero positive support is mathematically degenerate; boundary simulation provides the genuine predictive policy score.
